title: Unit 1: Planetary Dynamics, Earth’s Cosmic Coordinates & Interior Architecture
themes: Earth Rotation & Revolution Impacts
Longitudes, Latitudes & International Date Line
Internal Layering: Crust, Mantle, Core
Seismic Discontinuities (Conrad, Mohorovicic, Repetti, Gutenberg, Lehmann)
Direct vs Indirect Sources of Earth's Interior

title: Unit 2: The Plate Tectonics Paradigm, Seafloor Spreading & Paleomagnetism
themes: Alfred Wegener's Continental Drift Theory
Arthur Holmes' Thermal Convection Hypothesis
Harry Hess's Seafloor Spreading & Geomagnetic Reversals
Plate Tectonics: Convergent, Divergent, Transform Boundaries
Orogeny & Mountain Building

title: Unit 3: Diastrophism, Volcanism, Plutonic Intrusions & Seismic Mechanics
themes: Diastrophism: Epeirogenic vs Orogenic Movements
Volcanic Landforms: Intrusive (Batholiths, Laccoliths, Sills, Dykes) vs Extrusive
Mantle Plumes & Hotspot Volcanism (Deccan Traps, Hawaii)
Seismology: P-Waves, S-Waves, Surface Waves
Earthquake Shadow Zones & Epicenter Triangulation

title: Unit 4: Exogenic Geomorphic Processes: Weathering, Mass Movements & Erosion
themes: Physical / Mechanical Weathering (Exfoliation, Frost Wedging)
Chemical Weathering (Carbonation, Hydration, Oxidation)
Biological Weathering Mechanisms
Mass Movements: Slow (Creep, Solifluction) vs Rapid (Debris Flow, Landslides)
Erosion vs Denudation

title: Unit 5: Geomorphic Landform Suites: Fluvial, Karst, Glacial, Aeolian & Coastal
themes: Fluvial: Youth, Mature, Old Age Landforms (Gorges, Oxbow Lakes, Deltas)
Karst: Lapies, Sinkholes, Stalactites, Stalagmites, Poljes
Glacial: Cirques, Aretes, U-Shaped Valleys, Moraines, Eskers, Drumlins
Aeolian: Yardangs, Zeugens, Barchans, Seif Dunes, Loess
Coastal: Sea Cliffs, Caves, Stacks, Spits, Tombolos, Barrier Islands

title: Unit 6: Atmospheric Architecture, Insolation & Terrestrial Heat Budget
themes: Composition: Nitrogen, Oxygen, Argon, CO2, Aerosols
Thermal Layering: Troposphere, Stratosphere, Mesosphere, Thermosphere, Exosphere
Solar Constant & Insolation Variations
Terrestrial Radiation & Heat Budget Balance (100 units model)
Temperature Inversion: Radiation, Subsidence, Advection, Valley Inversions

title: Unit 7: Planetary Winds, Tri-Cellular Atmospheric Circulation & Jet Streams
themes: Atmospheric Pressure Belts (Equatorial Low, Subtropical High, Subpolar Low, Polar High)
Coriolis Force & Ferrel's Law
Tri-Cellular Model: Hadley, Ferrel, Polar Cells
Planetary Winds: Trade Winds, Westerlies, Polar Easterlies
Jet Streams: Polar Front & Subtropical Westerly Jets, Rossby Waves

title: Unit 8: Atmospheric Moisture, Frontogenesis & Tropical-Temperate Cyclones
themes: Humidity: Absolute, Specific, Relative Humidity & Dew Point
Adiabatic Lapse Rates: Dry (DALR) vs Saturated (SALR)
Cloud Typologies & Fog Classifications
Frontogenesis: Cold, Warm, Occluded, Stationary Fronts
Tropical vs Temperate (Extratropical) Cyclones: Genesis & Mechanics

title: Unit 9: Ocean Basin Morphology, Thermohaline Circulation & Dynamic Ocean Currents
themes: Hypsographic Curve & Continental Margin (Shelf, Slope, Rise, Abyssal Plain)
Submarine Canyons & Mid-Oceanic Ridges
Ocean Temperature & Salinity Distribution Factors
Surface Circulation: Gyres in Pacific, Atlantic, Indian Oceans
Thermohaline Conveyor Belt & Deep Ocean Circulation

title: Unit 10: Tidal Dynamics, Coral Reef Geomorphology & Marine Biogeochemistry
themes: Tidal Genesis: Gravitational Forces of Moon and Sun
Spring Tides vs Neap Tides & Semi-Diurnal Patterns
Coral Reef Ecology: Fringing Reefs, Barrier Reefs, Atolls
Theories of Coral Reef Formation (Darwin's Subsidence, Daly's Glacial Control)
Coral Bleaching Mechanisms & Marine Conservation
